description: A shell script serving as the entry point for initializing and configuring an OFBiz Docker container, including environment setup, data loading, database configuration, and component management.

methods.name: ofbiz_setup_env
methods.description: Validates and sets default environment variables for OFBiz initialization.

methods.name: create_ofbiz_runtime_directories
methods.description: Creates persistent directories to track initialization steps.

methods.name: run_init_hooks
methods.description: Executes hook scripts at various stages of initialization.

methods.name: load_data
methods.description: Loads seed, demo, or no data into OFBiz based on configuration.

methods.name: load_admin_user
methods.description: Creates and loads admin user credentials with hashed password.

methods.name: disable_component
methods.description: Disables a specific OFBiz component by modifying its XML configuration.

methods.name: disable_components
methods.description: Disables multiple OFBiz components based on a comma-separated list.

methods.name: apply_configuration
methods.description: Applies configuration changes such as AJP port, host, URL prefix, and component disabling.

methods.name: configure_database
methods.description: Sets up database connection parameters and downloads PostgreSQL driver if needed.

methods.name: shutdown_ofbiz
methods.description: Sends shutdown signal to OFBiz process.

methods.name: _main
methods.description: Main execution function that orchestrates the initialization process and then executes the passed command.
